overview.description: The 21Shares Sui Staking ETF Common Shares of Beneficial Interest Shares (TSUI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sui, short usd currency. The fund is passively managed, providing exposure to the price movement of Sui (SUI), net of fees and expenses. The fund will not invest directly in SUI TSUI was launched on Feb 24, 2026 and is issued by 21Shares.
